tiles.name: Total Errors
tiles.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as "Total Errors" FROM useraction WHERE ((name LIKE "%getappconfig timed out%" OR name LIKE "%checkversion request failed%" OR name LIKE "%appiniteffect%catcherror%" OR name LIKE "%loadgeolocation%catcherror%") OR (name LIKE "%biocatch.service.ts init failed%" OR name LIKE "%biocatch.service.ts startnative failed%" OR name LIKE "%biocatch caninit timeout%" OR name LIKE "%biocatch readiness timeout%" OR name LIKE "%biocatch.service.ts requestpermissions failed%") OR (name LIKE "%androidconsenttimeout%" OR name LIKE "%otsdktimeout%" OR name LIKE "%otconsentcallbacktimeout%" OR name LIKE "%startsdk failure callback%" OR name LIKE "%updateotconsentsplugins - error%"))

tiles.name: App Init Errors
tiles.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as "App Init Errors" FROM useraction WHERE (name LIKE "%getappconfig timed out%" OR name LIKE "%checkversion request failed%" OR name LIKE "%appiniteffect%catcherror%" OR name LIKE "%loadgeolocation%catcherror%")

tiles.name: BioCatch Errors
tiles.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as "BioCatch Errors" FROM useraction WHERE (name LIKE "%biocatch.service.ts init failed%" OR name LIKE "%biocatch.service.ts startnative failed%" OR name LIKE "%biocatch caninit timeout%" OR name LIKE "%biocatch readiness timeout%" OR name LIKE "%biocatch.service.ts requestpermissions failed%")

tiles.name: OneTrust Errors
tiles.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as "OneTrust Errors" FROM useraction WHERE (name LIKE "%androidconsenttimeout%" OR name LIKE "%otsdktimeout%" OR name LIKE "%otconsentcallbacktimeout%" OR name LIKE "%startsdk failure callback%" OR name LIKE "%updateotconsentsplugins - error%")

tiles.name: GetAppConfig Timeout
tiles.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as "GetAppConfig Timeout" FROM useraction WHERE name LIKE "%getappconfig timed out%"

tiles.name: CheckVersion Failed
tiles.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as "CheckVersion Failed" FROM useraction WHERE name LIKE "%checkversion request failed%"

tiles.name: App Init catchErrors
tiles.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as "App Init catchErrors" FROM useraction WHERE (name LIKE "%appiniteffect%catcherror%" OR name LIKE "%loadgeolocation%catcherror%")

tiles.name: BioCatch Init Failures
tiles.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as "BioCatch Init Failures" FROM useraction WHERE (name LIKE "%biocatch.service.ts init failed%" OR name LIKE "%biocatch.service.ts startnative failed%")

tiles.name: BioCatch Runtime Timeouts
tiles.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as "BioCatch Runtime Timeouts" FROM useraction WHERE (name LIKE "%biocatch caninit timeout%" OR name LIKE "%biocatch readiness timeout%")

tiles.name: BioCatch Permissions
tiles.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as "BioCatch Permissions" FROM useraction WHERE name LIKE "%biocatch.service.ts requestpermissions failed%"

tiles.name: OneTrust Timeouts
tiles.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as "OneTrust Timeouts" FROM useraction WHERE (name LIKE "%androidconsenttimeout%" OR name LIKE "%otsdktimeout%" OR name LIKE "%otconsentcallbacktimeout%")

tiles.name: OneTrust SDK Failures
tiles.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as "OneTrust SDK Failures" FROM useraction WHERE name LIKE "%startsdk failure callback%"

tiles.name: OneTrust Plugin Errors
tiles.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as "OneTrust Plugin Errors" FROM useraction WHERE name LIKE "%updateotconsentsplugins - error%"

tiles.name: Total OneTrust Events
tiles.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as "Total Events" FROM useraction WHERE name STARTSWITH "one-trust.service.ts "

tiles.name: OneTrust Failures
tiles.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as "Failures + Errors" FROM useraction WHERE name STARTSWITH "one-trust.service.ts " AND (name LIKE "%failure%" OR name LIKE "%error%")

tiles.name: SDK Init Success
tiles.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as "SDK Init Success" FROM useraction WHERE name STARTSWITH "one-trust.service.ts " AND name LIKE "%handlesdkinitsuccess%"

tiles.name: SDK Init Failures
tiles.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as "SDK Init Failures" FROM useraction WHERE name STARTSWITH "one-trust.service.ts " AND name LIKE "%startsdk failure callback%"

tiles.name: Init Native
tiles.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as "Init Native" FROM useraction WHERE name STARTSWITH "one-trust.service.ts " AND name LIKE "%initializenativeonetrust%"

tiles.name: Start SDK
tiles.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as "Start SDK" FROM useraction WHERE name STARTSWITH "one-trust.service.ts " AND name LIKE "%startonetrustsdk%"

tiles.name: Init Success
tiles.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as "Init Success" FROM useraction WHERE name STARTSWITH "one-trust.service.ts " AND name LIKE "%handlesdkinitsuccess%"

tiles.name: Init Failure
tiles.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as "Init Failure" FROM useraction WHERE name STARTSWITH "one-trust.service.ts " AND name LIKE "%startsdk failure%"

tiles.name: Register Listeners
tiles.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as "Register Listeners" FROM useraction WHERE name STARTSWITH "one-trust.service.ts " AND name LIKE "%registeroteventlisteners%"

tiles.name: Get Consent
tiles.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as "Get Consent" FROM useraction WHERE name STARTSWITH "one-trust.service.ts " AND name LIKE "%getconsentstatusforcategory%"

tiles.name: Sync Webview
tiles.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as "Sync Webview" FROM useraction WHERE name STARTSWITH "one-trust.service.ts " AND name LIKE "%syncotwebviewwithmobconsent%"

tiles.name: Sync+Start Web
tiles.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as "Sync+Start Web" FROM useraction WHERE name STARTSWITH "one-trust.service.ts " AND name LIKE "%syncconsentandstartwebot%"

tiles.name: Update Plugins
tiles.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as "Update Plugins" FROM useraction WHERE name STARTSWITH "one-trust.service.ts " AND name LIKE "%updateotconsentsplugins%"

tiles.name: Dead Flows
tiles.query: SELECT COUNT(*) as "Dead Flows" FROM useraction WHERE name STARTSWITH "one-trust.service.ts " AND name LIKE "%dead flow%"

tiles.name: Top OneTrust Events by Count
tiles.query: SELECT name as "Event", COUNT(*) as "Count" FROM useraction WHERE name STARTSWITH "one-trust.service.ts " GROUP BY name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

tiles.name: Events by App Version
tiles.query: SELECT usersession.appVersion as "App Version", COUNT(*) as "Events" FROM useraction WHERE name STARTSWITH "one-trust.service.ts " GROUP BY usersession.appVersion ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

tiles.name: Dead Flow Drill-Down
tiles.query: SELECT name as "Event", usersession.osFamily as "OS", usersession.appVersion as "App Version", COUNT(*) as "Count" FROM useraction WHERE name STARTSWITH "one-trust.service.ts " AND name LIKE "%dead flow%" GROUP BY name, usersession.osFamily, usersession.appVersion ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
